authority_boundary: The contract check is advisory in warn mode and a push/PR chokepoint in enforce mode. A trailer's presence never proves the session was real, the work was reviewed, or the output is correct; trailer identifiers are reconciled against the session store by a separate hub-side audit. Bypass trailers are always allowed but always logged.
remediation: Material work needs a DAD lifecycle trace. Run `asset-dir agent preflight --repo . --agent <agent> --task "<task>"` before the work and `asset-dir agent postflight --session <id> ...` after it, then include the printed `DAD-Session: <id>` trailer in a commit message (or the PR body). For a reviewed emergency, use `DAD-Bypass: <your-name>: <reason>` — bypasses are logged and reviewed.

probation.promotion_criteria: At least 4 weeks or 30 protected-path pushes observed in warn mode; false-positive rate under 5 percent of flagged pushes; cold-agent simulation produces the remediation message; human sign-off flips mode to enforce.
probation.kill_criteria: Persistent false positives on non-material changes, or the gate blocking urgent work without a workable bypass: downgrade to a preflight warning per docs/HARNESS_VS_DETERMINISTIC_ENFORCEMENT.md.
